subject.title: La Puente Valley County Water District Board

text: As your water board director, it has been an honor to serve the residents of La Puente for the past 25 years. I am a lifelong resident of La Puente and have raised my three children here with my wife Betty. During my time on the water board, I have been a part of various programs to benefit our community. My goal has always been and will continue to be to provide the residents of La Puente clean and safe water at one of the lowest rates in the Valley. I look forward to continuing to serve you on the La Puente Valley Water Board.

text: Henry Hernandez has been a La Puente resident for more than 65 years. He is a retired Department of Defense employee who served for 40 years as a Quality Assurance Representative. I am completing my fourth full term as a Board Director. Appointed as President and Vice President during my full terms. My goals are to see the district water plan is incorporated and accomplished. Work with fellow appointed directors on implementation of initiatives and resolution of water improvements. Supportive of the needs of the community to have a successful administration. Have helped to maintain lower rate increases to water providers other than surrounding communities. Some of district's accomplishments for the past 4 years.
1. Maintain Districts revenues and Expenses.
2. Investing in Infrastructure.
3. Final permitting steps to Water Treatment Facility (PVOU-IZ).
4. Offering Paperless Billing.
5. District's mission of providing high quality water.

text: My name is Georgene Navarrete, and I am honored to be a first-time candidate for the Board of Directors of the La Puente Valley County Water District.

For 29 years, I have proudly served our community as a Site Supervisor Aide with the Hacienda La Puente Unified School District. In addition, I work for the City of La Puente as a Recreation Service Leader. Throughout my career, I have worked closely with students, families, and staff, building relationships based on trust, service, and dedication.

My commitment to our community extends beyond my career. I had served as a board member of the Fairgrove Academy PTO, served as Secretary and Treasurer of Kiwanis Club of La Puente, and was President of the La Puente Warrior Field Corps. These experiences have strengthened my leadership skills, fiscal responsibility, and commitment to serving others.

I am running because I believe our community deserves dedicated, transparent, and accountable leadership. If elected, I will work to protect our water resources, ensure reliable water service, and make thoughtful decisions that serve the best interests of our residents.
Although this is my first campaign for the Water District Board, my years of public service and community involvement have prepared me to serve with integrity, respect, and dedication.
I respectfully ask for your vote and the opportunity to represent you on the La Puente Valley County Water District Board of Directors.

text: Occupation: Public Servant

My name is Charlie Chavez. I am a resident in the City of La Puente, a father, a public servant, and a longtime community volunteer. I am invested in our community and care deeply about the future of our city and the quality of life of its residents.

I hold a Master of Science in Emergency Management from the University of Southern California, a Bachelor of Arts in Communication from California State University, Los Angeles, and an Associate of Arts in Communication from Rio Hondo College. My professional experience in public service has provided me with leadership, problem-solving, and emergency management skills, along with an understanding of accountability and responsible management of public resources.

I have served on the Parks and Recreation Commission and volunteered with youth and family programs, including AYSO, CASA, and local after-school programs. These experiences have strengthened my commitment to community service and responsive leadership.

As a resident and homeowner, I understand the importance of dependable infrastructure, transparency, and responsible decision-making. I am seeking election to the La Puente Valley County Water District Board to listen to residents, provide accountable leadership, and help ensure the district serves our community professionally and effectively.
I RESPECTFULLY ASK FOR YOUR VOTE.

text: For nearly 20 years, La Puente has been my home. I attended school locally and have had the privilege of watching our community grow and develop. I have participated in local food drives, supported small businesses, and believe strongly in giving back to the community that has given me so much.

My career in healthcare has taught me the importance of responsibility, communication, accountability, and putting people first. I have worked as a Patient Scheduler and currently serve as a Radiology Assistant. Every day, I work with patients and healthcare professionals in an environment where attention to detail and responsible decision-making matter.

As a member of the La Puente Valley County Water District Board of Directors, my priorities would be ensuring our community has access to safe, reliable, high-quality water, reducing unnecessary and wasteful spending, and making responsible use of ratepayer funds.
I believe public service means listening to the community, asking difficult questions, and making decisions based on what best serves the people we represent.
I would be honored to serve the community I have called home for nearly two decades, and I respectfully ask for your vote.
